description: Expected results for SWAP's official test case tests/cases/1.hupselbrook (SWAP 4.2.0, github.com/SWAP-model/swap). 3 years (2002-2004), Hupselse Beek site (NL), grass/maize/potato crop files, drainage system, heat and solute transport on. inputs/ are the unmodified files from the SWAP git tree (git show HEAD). The case ships NO reference output in git (its CI test only checks that swap runs to the end), so values were recorded from real runs of the server's built SWAP. Two clean runs gave byte-identical result.blc, result.inc, result.vap and result.sba (deterministic); tolerances only allow for the 2-decimal print of .blc and 0.1 cm print of groundwater level.

numeric_checks.name: n_balance_years
numeric_checks.why: result.blc has one yearly balance block per year 2002-2004

numeric_checks.name: n_monthly_increments
numeric_checks.why: result.inc has one row per month, 36 months

numeric_checks.name: n_profile_snapshots
numeric_checks.why: result.vap holds the initial profile plus 36 monthly profiles

numeric_checks.name: initial_storage_cm
numeric_checks.why: soil water in the 200 cm profile at start (from initial groundwater level)

numeric_checks.name: total_rain_cm
numeric_checks.why: gross rainfall read from 283.met over 3 years (input passes through)

numeric_checks.name: total_irrigation_cm
numeric_checks.why: the one fixed irrigation given in swap.swp

numeric_checks.name: total_interception_cm
numeric_checks.why: rain caught by the crop canopy

numeric_checks.name: total_transpiration_cm
numeric_checks.why: actual crop water use, main output of the crop/root water uptake part

numeric_checks.name: max_abs_balance_deviation_cm
numeric_checks.why: water balance closes every year (SWAP's own Balance Deviation line)

numeric_checks.name: mean_groundwater_level_cm
numeric_checks.why: mean month-end groundwater level over 36 months

recorded_with: run_reference.py --print-values: KI tools/run_swap.py (with --binary <SWAP 4.2.0 build> --allow-unpinned-binary) then tools/parse_swap_output.py, python_env Python
reference: No official reference output exists for this case: result.* files in the server's copy of the folder are untracked leftovers of an earlier local run (they match this run byte for byte except the 'Generated at' time line). Official check in SWAP's CI (pixi.toml test-linux) = swap runs to normal completion; our 'finished normally' check covers that.
notes: Only step besides copying: swap_linux.swp.template is copied to swap.swp, exactly as SWAP's own test task does. No input file is changed.
